sources.title: AI4Bharat Models
sources.snippet: Indic Text-to-Speech Indic-TTS is an on-going research focusing on building multispeaker text-to-speech models for Indic languages. TTS involves two different models - an acoustic model, which is responsible for generating waveform for a given text; and a vocoder model, which is responsible for synthesizing voice from the generated waveform.
